rounds.prompt: How long would it take to listen to every country's national anthem back to back?
rounds.source: Alex Marshall, Mail & Guardian (19 August 2008): all 205 national anthems of the Beijing Olympics nations add up to 4 hours, 26 minutes and 25 seconds

rounds.prompt: If the combined wealth of every billionaire on Forbes' 2026 list were split evenly among everyone on Earth, how much would each person get?
rounds.source: Forbes, The World's Billionaires 2026: 3,428 billionaires worth a combined $20.1 trillion (net worths as of March 1, 2026) · United Nations, World Population Prospects 2024: about 8.3 billion people in 2026

rounds.prompt: What is the world record for the most skips of a single stone thrown across water?
rounds.source: Guinness World Records, most skips of a skimming stone (Kurt Steiner, 2013)
